measurement_contract.window_grid: 5 native seconds, stride1, anchored at each contiguous observed phase's first row
measurement_contract.speed: sum valid clipped adjacent path mm / valid observed native seconds
measurement_contract.coverage: valid adjacent native seconds / full5seconds; never bridge long gaps
measurement_contract.removal: frame-assigned counts on(start,end], omit long/missing predecessor intervals; divide by full5seconds
measurement_contract.boundary_counts: frame endpoint assignment, no subframe removal interpolation
measurement_contract.stationary: exactly zero observed displacement, not inferred from absent removal
measurement_contract.phase: no cross-phase_id segments or windows; predrilling and unknown phases excluded
measurement_contract.missing_phase_id: deterministic identities for contiguous existing labels; no missing phase labels inferred
measurement_contract.display: native window endpoints mapped to video clock only for review clips
measurement_contract.pose: all vision tool positions; not restricted to contact or removal frames
